caption:
Radians are hiding on your reference sheet.

The sheet says a circle is 360°, or 2π radians, so 180° = π. 150° × π/180 = 5π/6.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: 180° = π. That's already on your reference sheet. 150° = 5π/6.

youtube.title: Degrees to Radians: It's Hiding on the SAT Sheet
youtube.description: The conversion formula isn't printed on the SAT reference sheet, but 360° = 2π radians is. Worked example: 150° = 5π/6 radians.
